data.credibility: Management generally hits order inflow and working capital targets, though they missed the FY26 revenue guidance of 15% (delivering 11.8%). Margins significantly outperformed initial expectations. Overall, they are reliable on core operational goals.

lines.line: Promised 10% inflow growth for FY26; delivered successfully.
Promised 15% revenue growth for FY26; missed with actual 11.8%.
Promised 12% working capital ratio for March 26; delivered 4.1%.
Promised 8.3%-8.5% EBITDA margin; significantly outperformed, delivering 12.6%.
Expecting group order inflow growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
Expecting 10% to 12% revenue growth for FY27; tracking at 11.4%.
Expecting stable 7.8% margin for FY27; currently outperforming at 11.6%.
Expecting working capital around 10% in FY27; currently on track.
Targeting 10% to 12% order inflow CAGR under Lakshya 31.
Targeting 12% to 15% revenue growth CAGR under Lakshya 31.

bull: Working-capital days tightened impressively from 28 to -27 over five years.
Operating cash flow reached 115% of reported profit over five years, showing strong cash conversion.
Infrastructure segment secured massive orders worth ₹1,99,064 crore in FY 2025-26.
bear: EBITDA margin narrowed considerably from 17.3% in FY21 to 12.7% in FY26.
Management missed their FY26 revenue growth target of 15%, achieving only 11.8%.
The company is heavily geared with a high debt-to-equity ratio of 1.24 (borrowings of ₹140,300 cr against net worth of ₹113,029 cr).
